label: Facing a single raise - 6-max, 100bb
source: Hand-authored baseline consistent with published solver-derived 6-max 100bb defence ranges against a ~2.5x open, trimmed for microstakes rake. Keyed by hero seat AND opener seat, because defending the big blind against a button open and against an under-the-gun open are different problems and averaging them hides the leak. NOT solver output. REVISED: the first draft's big-blind defence was far too tight (36% vs a button open, against pot odds justifying nearer 58%) -- widened. Treat blind-defence numbers here as the least reliable part of the tool.
